name: Solved cube has no fake moves
description: Verifies the solved default cube is accepted and does not invent moves.
expected: The app reports the cube is already solved and displays no fake sequence.

name: Scramble and verify a solution
description: Verifies a generated scramble can be solved and the output is checked against the solved state.
steps: Press Solve cube and wait for solver preparation
expected: A move list appears, the full algorithm is available, and no validation error is shown.

name: Paint stickers in 3D and flat net
description: Checks stickers can be edited from the interactive canvas and the flat net, with undo available.
steps: Tap a non-center sticker in the 3D cube
Tap a non-center sticker in the flat net
expected: Sticker colors update, centers remain fixed, and undo restores the prior cube state.

name: Camera color assist and mobile layout
description: Checks the camera flow is usable on mobile and has a manual fallback.
steps: Open TwistLab on a secure camera-capable browser
Choose a face and capture colors
expected: The chosen face is updated locally with a reminder to review detected colors; camera failure explains manual entry.

name: Reject invalid cube sticker counts
description: Confirms invalid sticker arrangements are not passed to the solver.
expected: A visible validation message reports incorrect counts or centers and no solution is shown.
